translations.web: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
translations.bsb: He who loves pleasure will become poor; the one who loves wine and oil will never be rich.
translations.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
translations.asv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
